If no arguments are provided then it returns transportation options for specified locations, if source location is not provided it uses the user's current location. The default user experience is that it opens a window that shows a user transportation options with prefilled source and destination for the next week

business_name.description: Name of business as destination for transportation query

business_type.description: Type of business as destination for transportation query

date.description: date for which to query the tickets

place_name.description: name of the place either source or destination to query the tickets

time.description: time at which to query the tickets

timeofday.description: time of the day for which to book tickets

transport_name.description: specific train name to query tickets

transport_type.description: type of transportation to query tickets

function.name: transport.taxi
function.description: Book taxi tickets from a source location to a destination location. If no arguments are provided then it returns taxi tickets for the specified locations, if source location is not provided it uses the user's current location. The default user experience is that it opens a window that allows a user to book a taxi ticket with prefilled source and destination for the next week

date.description: date for which to book the tickets

place_name.description: name of the place either source or destination to book the tickets

time.description: time at which to book the tickets

timeofday.description: time of the day for which to book tickets

transport_agency.description: agency through which to book the transportation tickets

transport_type.description: type of transportation to book tickets

function.name: transport.ticket
function.description: Book train tickets from a source location to a destination location. If no arguments are provided then it returns train tickets for the specified locations, if source location is not provided it uses the user's current location. The default user experience is that it opens a window that allows a user to book a train ticket with prefilled source and destination for the next week

date.description: datefor which to book the tickets

place_name.description: name of the place either source or destination to book the tickets

time.description: time at which to book the tickets

timeofday.description: time of the day for which to book tickets

transport_descriptor.description: specify additional customizations while booking tickets

transport_name.description: specific train name to book tickets

function.name: transport.traffic
function.description: Get current details on traffic information for specified locations and routes. If no arguments are provided then it returns traffic information for the route from home to work or work to home, depending on the user's current location. The default user experience is that it opens the navigation app with the source and destination locations set along with display current traffic and alternate routes

place_name.description: place for which to check traffic information

time.description: timeat which to check traffic information

function.name: weather.query
function.description: Query for weather information for a specific location, date or for descriptors. If no arguments are provided then it returns the weather right now for the user's current location and the forecast for the remainder of the day if applicable. The default user experience is that it opens a window to display weather forecast for the next 7 days for the user's current location

date.description: date for which to query the weather app

event_name.description: event to find details for which toquery the weather app

general_frequency.description: frequencyat which to querythe weather app

place_name.description: name of placefor which toquery the weather app

time.description: time period over which to querythe weather app

timeofday.description: time of day for which to querythe weather app

weather_descriptor.description: description of weather conditions for which to query the weather app
